description: This file defines the Filesystem class, which extends Symfony's Filesystem component, providing an additional method dumpFile to write content to a file with error handling.

classes.name: Filesystem
classes.description: A subclass of Symfony's Filesystem providing a dumpFile method that writes content to a file with directory creation and error handling.

methods.name: dumpFile
methods.description: Writes content to the specified filename, creating necessary directories and handling errors, throwing an IOException if writing fails.
